name: Peninsula Gardens Hand Roll | Party Popperz
description:
Another straight candy. Smokes very similar to our runtz with some subtle differences we think you'll absolutely love. 

Smooth burning, flavor transfer, and white ash with a good resin ring are key points we strive for harvest after harvest.
